description: T65 / UMS9230S — force get_lock_status() to report unlocked, including the global the AVB callback reads.

target.image: lk-sign.bin (stock LK extracted from the stock PAC)

why: get_lock_status() does not only return the state: it maintains the global _DAT_9f13d8c8 (0x9F13D8C8). The AVB 'is device unlocked' callback FUN_9f0680b0 reads that global directly and never calls get_lock_status(). Patching only the return value therefore splits the state — callers see 'unlocked' while AVB still sees 'locked', and ro.boot.verifiedbootstate stays green. Writing the global as well makes both paths agree (verified: orange / unlocked).
